description.blurb: This moon of Jupiter, like many others, was discovered in 2003 at the Mauna Kea Observatory in Hawaii.
description.more: S/2003 J 9 is a member of the Carme group, and has a mean radius of about 1,600 feet (half a kilometer). At a mean distance of about 15 million miles (23.4 million kilometers) from Jupiter, the satellite takes about 733 Earth days to complete one orbit.
